$comment: Opgehaald uit het ODCN-cluster met: kubectl get --raw /openapi/v3/apis/quay.k8s.rijksapps.nl/v1alpha1 . Dit is de waarheid over de Organization-CR; onze sjablonen worden hiertegen getoetst.

schema.description:
Organization is the Schema for the organizations API.
It represents a Quay organisation with all its associated configuration.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and may reject unrecognized values. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: OrganizationSpec defines the desired state of the Quay Organisation.

authorization.description: Authorization configures teams, OIDC sync and default permissions.

enabled.description:
Enabled controls whether default prototype permissions are set.
Defaults to true.

authLevels.description:
AuthLevels lists the authorisation levels to create.
Each level results in a team named "<customer>-<tenant>-<level.name>-group".
The group is synced to the OIDC group of the same name.
Defaults to admin/developer/viewer all with role Member.

items.description:
AuthLevelSpec defines a single authorisation level that maps to a
Quay team role.

name.description: Name is the short name of the level, e.g. "admin", "developer", "viewer".

role.description: Role is the Quay team role assigned to this level.

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether teams are synchronised via OIDC. Defaults to true.

customerName.description:
CustomerName is the name of the customer. It also becomes the Quay
organisation name.

preventDeletion.description:
PreventDeletion blocks deletion of this Organization CR when set to true.
The controller will not remove its finalizer until this field is set back
to false, preventing accidental removal of the Quay organisation and its
associated resources.

proxyCache.description:
ProxyCache configures this organisation as a proxy cache for an upstream
registry. When enabled, the Quay org name becomes
"<proxyCache.friendlyName>-<customerName>".

credentialsSecretRef.description:
CredentialsSecretRef references a Secret in the same namespace as the
Organization CR that contains upstream registry credentials.
Expected keys: "username" and "password".

name.description:
Name of the referent.
This field is effectively required, but due to backwards compatibility is
allowed to be empty. Instances of this type with an empty value here are
almost certainly wrong.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether this proxy cache configuration is applied.

friendlyName.description:
FriendlyName is a short label for the upstream registry, used as the
prefix of the Quay organisation name. Must not contain a dot (".").
Example: "quay" results in an org named "quay-<customerName>".
Required when enabled is true.

upstreamRegistry.description:
UpstreamRegistry is the URL of the upstream registry, e.g. "quay.io".
Required when enabled is true.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: spec.proxyCache.friendlyName and upstreamRegistry are required when enabled is true

quayInstanceRef.description:
QuayInstanceRef is the name of the cluster-scoped QuayInstance CR that
defines which Quay registry this Organisation lives in. If omitted, the
controller selects the QuayInstance with Default set to true.

quota.description:
Quota controls the storage quota for the organisation.
Defaults: LimitGiB=10, WarningPercent=80, RejectPercent=100.

limitGiB.description: LimitGiB is the maximum storage in gibibytes. Defaults to 10.

rejectPercent.description: RejectPercent rejects pushes at this usage percentage.

warningPercent.description: WarningPercent triggers a warning notification at this usage percentage.

robot.description: Robot configures the Quay robot account for the organisation.

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether a robot account is created. Defaults to true.

imagePullSecret.description:
ImagePullSecret controls the Kubernetes Secret holding the robot's
Docker config credentials.

additionalLabels.description: AdditionalLabels are extra labels added to the created Secret.

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether an imagePullSecret is created. Defaults to true.

name.description:
Name of the created imagePullSecret.
Defaults to "<organizationName>-robot-pull-secret".

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether token rotation is active. Defaults to true.

retentionDays.description:
RetentionDays specifies the number of days a token remains valid.
After this many days the controller regenerates the token.

name.description:
Name of the robot account within Quay.
Defaults to "<organizationName>-robot".

readerMembers.description:
ReaderMembers is a list of additional Quay usernames to add to the
robot-reader team alongside the robot account itself.

suffix.description:
Suffix is an optional string appended to the Quay organisation name
with a "-" separator, e.g. suffix "acc" results in "<customerName>-acc".
When combined with a proxy cache the format becomes
"<friendlyName>-<customerName>-<suffix>".
This field is immutable after creation.

tenants.description:
Tenants is an ordered list of tenant names (e.g. ["test","acc","prd"]).
Teams are created per tenant per auth level.

status.description: OrganizationStatus defines the observed state of Organization.

boundQuayInstance.description:
BoundQuayInstance is the name of the QuayInstance CR that this
Organisation is reconciled against. Set by the controller after
resolving the (possibly defaulted) quayInstanceRef.

conditions.description: Conditions reflect the overall reconciliation state.

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.
This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description:
message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.
This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.
Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field,
and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API.
The value should be a CamelCase string.
This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

imagePullSecret.description: ImagePullSecret reports the name and token state of the robot's imagePullSecret.

name.description: Name is the Kubernetes Secret name containing the robot's Docker config credentials.

tokenExpiryDate.description: TokenExpiryDate is the date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which the current robot token expires and will be rotated.

tokenLastRotatedAt.description: TokenLastRotatedAt is the compact UTC timestamp (yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ) of the most recent token rotation.

lastSyncTime.description: LastSyncTime records the last time reconciliation against Quay completed.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the .metadata.generation this status corresponds to.

proxyCache.description: ProxyCache reports the proxy cache configuration state.

credentialsConfigured.description:
CredentialsConfigured is true when upstream registry credentials were
loaded from a Secret and sent to Quay. False means the proxy cache is
configured for anonymous/public access.

credentialsHash.description:
CredentialsHash is a SHA-256 digest of the credentials last applied to
Quay. It is used to detect secret rotation without comparing plaintext
values. Quay redacts passwords in GET responses so direct comparison is
not possible.

ready.description: Ready indicates whether the proxy cache is fully configured.

upstream.description: Upstream is the upstream registry URL.

quayOrgName.description:
QuayOrgName is the actual organisation name in Quay (may differ from
customerName when a proxy cache is enabled).

robotAccountName.description: RobotAccountName is the fully-qualified Quay robot account name.

teams.description: Teams lists the current state of all managed Quay teams.

items.description: TeamStatus reports the current state of a single Quay team.

memberCount.description: MemberCount is the number of members in the team as reported by Quay.

name.description: Name is the Quay team name.

oidcSynced.description: OIDCSynced indicates whether OIDC sync is currently active for this team.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: spec.proxyCache cannot be added or removed after creation
spec.proxyCache.enabled, friendlyName, and upstreamRegistry are immutable after creation
